PLUGIN_DB_PIN_KEYS.doc: The optional words of a pin, each this key, an equals sign and its value. Each appears at most once, in either order; a word with any other key is not a pin's.

verdict.doc: the qualification verdict of the pinned bytes, a word of PIN_VERDICTS of plugin-hostd-protocol's domain pin

pool.doc: the thread pool word of the pinned bytes, a word of PIN_POOLS of plugin-hostd-protocol's domain pin

PLUGIN_DB_PIN_CHANGES.doc: What counts as changed: a pin holds the digests of the plugin's files and the fingerprint of its parameter layout, and only these two differ from it. Anything else about a plugin, its name or its version included, changes no pin.

files.doc: a pinned file is gone, or its bytes no longer have the digest the pin holds

layout.doc: the plugin's parameter layout no longer has the fingerprint the pin holds

PLUGIN_DB_PIN_LAYOUT_FORMATS.doc: The formats the layout serialisation is written for, as the first line of its bytes names them.

clap.doc: every parameter clap.params gives, sorted by id

lv2.doc: every control port, sorted by index
